fact: The health ministry's PNDS 4 for 2022-2030, dated November 2022, states that DHIS2 has been operational in all provinces since July 2022, sets the target of making it operational in all health districts by 2030, and plans (Action 2.2.7) to extend its deployment to districts not in the initial plan and to the level of the health centres.
title: Plan National de Développement Sanitaire (PNDS 4) 2022-2030
publisher: République du Tchad, Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Prévention
